title: Effects of a hybrid post-treatment on microstructure and mechanical properties of cold sprayed AA7050 deposits
InformationInFigures: Yes: morphologies of powder in Fig. 1., dimensions of dog-bone tensile sample, which was 35mm long, 2mm wide in the narrow section and 7mm wide on the ends. The 2mm wide segment was 10mm long. Porosity given in fig.3. Select microhardness, UTS, and EL values must be inferred from charts in figures 10 and 11. Elastic modulus can be inferred from stress-strain curve in fig. 11.

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: Shanghai buwei applied materials technology Co., Ltd.
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Material_Composition: Cu 0.24 wt %, Si 0.62 wt %, Mg 1.01 wt %, Fe 0.42 wt %, Cr 0.11 wt %, Al Bal.

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: Before EBSD analysis, the polished samples were treated using an Ilion II Model 697 argon-ion polisher. Mechanical polishing used on cross-sections for porosity analysis. The samples were etched with Keller’s reagent (95 mL H2O, 1 mL HF, 1.5 mL HCl, and 2.5 mL HNO3) for 10–20 seconds to examine the metallographic structure. Before TEM analysis, the samples were mechanically thinned to about 70 μm and then thinned in a mixed solution of 5% perchloric acid and 95% ethanol using a twin-jet electropolishing device (MTP-1A, China) at −30◦C.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: dense microstructure, with micro-defects present among some particles due to insufficient deformation. inhomogeneous, exhibiting fine grains areas and coarse grains areas. severse deformation implying that significant work-hardening effects exist. relatively high proportion of low angle grain boundaries. contained dendritic solute segregation
